commenti.body:
>similarly, I noticed little grey and black dots appearing on screen and disappearing after about 5 seconds, almost as if there was dust on the projector or something.

That IS dirt and scratches on the film reel: I'm assuming the copy you were shown is one that had been played quite a few times, and each time there's a degree of wear and tear added to the film.

Mild flickering is part of film projection. When projectors are in good running order, it’s barely noticeable, except for very bright scenes. If the projector is going out of calibration, flicker can get very noticeable.
